description: Rules for the stealth rungs: robots.txt gate and the one challenge-solver retry.

notes.text: Rungs that try to look like a person. They run only where robots.txt allows the URL, on every route including single /scrape (Harry, 2026-11-18, answer 8; ADR 0006). The plain and tls tiers are unchanged. Camoufox and the real-browser rung join this set when they are added.

The one gate the API configures at boot with a RobotsCache (index.ts). Unconfigured it allows everything, so tests and tools that build a pipeline without it read no robots.txt. PipelineDeps.stealthRobots overrides it per call.

helix-scrape runs Scrapling's Cloudflare solver only when asked, because the solver polls about 5 s on every page just to look for a challenge. So the API asks for it once, after the browser rung came back with a challenge verdict. The solver has a 20 s budget in helix-scrape (answer 10).
